workData.title: Bunshi Lab
workData.subTitle: Revamped Bunshi Mask’s e-commerce site, enhancing brand trust and usability, driving 300K+ unit sales across 160+ medical facilities.

content.text: Role
Senior Product Designer
Project Space
E-commerce
B2C
Growth Design

In early 2021, I joined Bunshi Mask as a UX/UI Designer to revamp their e-commerce site during the COVID-19 pandemic. The client aimed to establish a premium brand identity by showcasing their unique materials and technology, standing out in a competitive market.

Bunshi Mask offers the thinnest mask, reimagining every element—materials, stitching, silhouette, and filters. Trusted by over 160 medical facilities, it has sold over 300,000 units, making it a reliable and popular product.
The goal was to highlight the mask’s superior quality and innovation digitally, while ensuring a seamless shopping experience to boost sales and engagement.
Hypothesis
Optimizing the sign-up, cart, and checkout flows would increase conversions.
Interactive 3D models would enhance product perception and engagement.
Consistent branding and authentic customer feedback would drive traffic and sales.
Enhanced E-Commerce UX
Redesigned the sign-up, cart, and checkout flows for a seamless shopping experience.
Interactive 3D Visualization
Created 360-degree 3D models for customers to explore mask designs and features digitally.
Used brand colors in the 3D model backgrounds to strengthen identity and differentiate products.
Unified Branding and Social Strategy
Developed consistent, on-brand copywriting for product pages.
Redesigned social media to feature real customer feedback, boosting trust and engagement.
Cumulative Sales
Adoption by Medical Facilities
Impact
Improved UX increased sales and traffic while strengthening brand identity.
Trusted by 160+ medical facilities, achieving over 300,000 units sold.
Featured authentic customer feedback enhanced trust and engagement.
Learning
Interactive visualization improves customer understanding and premium product engagement.
Seamless UX in shopping flows is critical for high conversion rates.
Real customer feedback builds trust and drives sales effectively.
This project successfully elevated Bunshi Mask’s e-commerce presence, driving measurable results and enhancing brand value.

next.title: Who'z
next.subTitle: Built a platform for teams to create and embed personalized web pages, enhancing small business visibility and recruitment.

content.text: Role
Senior Product Designer
Project Space
Talent Management Platform
0-1 Projects
B2B
B2C
SaaS

As a Senior Product Designer for Who’z, I led the creation of a user-friendly platform designed to help employees and teams create and manage personalized web pages. Serving as a talent management tool and cloud service, Who’z simplifies the process of creating, managing, and embedding employee and team profiles into existing websites.

The platform focuses on enhancing team visibility, building trust, and improving recruitment efforts, making it particularly valuable for small businesses seeking to promote their talent and team capabilities.

The core functionalities of Who’z include member management, team management, and profile customization. Its goal is to simplify the creation of employee introduction pages that can be embedded or shared, enabling businesses to effectively promote their teams.
Hypothesis
A seamless process for creating, managing, and embedding team profiles will drive platform adoption among SMBs.
Enhanced team visibility will strengthen organizational trust and improve recruitment outcomes.
An intuitive design will make the platform accessible, even for non-technical users.
Core Design Features
Built an intuitive member and team management system to streamline profile organization and updates.
Added profile customization options to enable businesses to highlight individual talents and team strengths.
Embedding and Sharing Tools
Designed features to embed completed pages into existing websites, ensuring seamless integration with online assets.
Integrated social sharing capabilities to expand team visibility across various platforms.
Scalable Design for SMBs
Simplified the UX to make the platform highly accessible and user-friendly for small businesses with limited technical expertise.
Impact
Enhanced team and employee visibility with easy-to-create web pages, boosting trust and credibility.
Strengthened recruitment efforts by enabling businesses to effectively showcase their talent and team capabilities.
Delivered a cost-efficient, scalable talent management solution tailored for small businesses.
Learning
Simple, accessible features are essential for platform adoption, especially among smaller organizations.
Embedding and sharing tools significantly expand the reach and visibility of teams.
Clear and intuitive profile management tools build trust and improve platform engagement.
